title: Kitchen panelling and cooker hood surround
summary: V-groove panelling round a kitchen, a boxed-in cooker hood and a tall panelled unit.
intro: A kitchen in Crouch End, panelled in V-groove MDF above the worktops and at dado height round the dining side. The cooker hood is boxed in to match, and a tall panelled unit stands at the end of the run, so the whole room hangs together.
